repos.name: chatgpt-conversation-corpus
repos.note: The sanitized corpus derived from `dev/`; pre-release, sanitization in progress.

repos.name: cmri-agenda
repos.note: The research agenda (2026-10-21), its evidence (questions ledger, public dataset catalog, novelty checks) and the designs of studies not yet frozen; private until each protocol is frozen.

repos.name: cmri-knowledge-networks
repos.note: Published: Complex Networks 2025, Springer chapter online 2026-02-25. Holds the conference paper plus the shared pipeline (`code/`) and reproducibility data (`data/`).

repos.name: cmri-temporal-networks
repos.note: Rejected at PLOS Complex Systems 2026-04-27. Branch `pilot/iscs-2027-calibration` holds the October 2026 calibration that supersedes the old growth/beta claims and supplies the densification exponents the ISCS 2027 paper reports.

repos.name: cmri-hierarchical-memory
repos.note: Accepted at ISCS 2026; Springer SSDC 709 proceedings forthcoming. Formerly `agentic/`.

repos.name: cmri-hierarchical-memory-extended
repos.note: In preparation: the extended journal version of the ISCS 2026 paper for the Applied Network Science ISCS 2026 collection (due 2026-12-04). Pins the camera-ready and the addendum's results; corrects the small-world claim.

repos.name: cmri-embedding-dynamics
repos.note: Partial draft (abstract + validation section). Proposed consolidation with Semantic Dynamics; see `docs/research/DYNAMICS-CONSOLIDATION.md`.

repos.name: cmri-semantic-dynamics
repos.note: Full draft (LaTeX is more complete than the Markdown). Several of its mathematical claims failed the October 2026 audit.

repos.name: cmri-operational-memex
repos.note: Outline plus working infrastructure.

repos.name: cmri-portfolio-wave1
repos.note: Six PRISM experiments; uniform history pooling beats the last two messages for next-user prediction (+.034 MiniLM, +.019 E5, raw cosine). Holds the PRISM development caches, the source manifest and the `cmri_wave` pipeline every study imports.

repos.name: cmri-history-falsification
repos.note: The pooling gain survives four views of the past; the user/assistant asymmetry depends on the forecast origin, not the roles. Supplies the synthetic processes and the fitted centers.

repos.name: cmri-history-specificity
repos.note: HS01 to HS04: no ranking gain over strong short-context controls; the cosine gain persists.

repos.name: cmri-grounded-dependencies
repos.note: CGDIALOG human labels: recency alone matches embedding augmentations.

repos.name: cmri-integration-measurement
repos.note: Zero clear same-premise revisions in 100 PRISM windows; no-go on this source. Its AI-labelled cases are excluded from the F3 reliability draw.

repos.name: cmri-semantic-measurement
repos.note: ThoughtTrace: sequence-trajectory features are reliably worse than pooling. Supplies the pinned ONNX encoders (MiniLM, E5) every study uses.

repos.name: cmri-selective-forgetting
repos.note: LongMemEval: the benchmark had no cross-topic cases, so the bridge hypothesis went untested.

repos.name: cmri-iscs-2027
repos.note: Frozen PRISM reserve confirmation of the history-pooling gain (MiniLM +.025, E5 +.018) and Protocol 2, the reach decomposition confirmed on fresh PRISM and WildChat samples. Home of the ISCS 2027 paper (`paper/`, build with `make`), the NetSci 2027 abstract and the locked environment for all study code (`uv sync`).

repos.name: cmri-wildchat-replication
repos.note: Frozen cross-collection replication on WildChat-4.8M passed in both encoders (MiniLM +.021, E5 +.016; 482 IP components, 801 conversations).

repos.name: cmri-history-reach
repos.note: Draws and encodes WildChat samples outside every earlier one: the exploratory long-conversation sample (557 conversations of 20 to 40 messages) and the fresh sample for Protocol 2.

repos.name: cmri-person-networks
repos.note: Study 1: how personal is a person's knowledge network? Frozen confirmation on 250 held-out WildChat identities passed in both encoders (2026-10-21): networks are more fragmented, more clustered and more temporally episodic than size- and density-matched pools of strangers, but strangers' conversations on the same topics reproduce about 90% of it. Study 1b's frozen confirmation on 449 fresh light users passed (2026-10-22): sittings and topic periods account for most of the time locality. Home of the NetSci 2027 abstract.

iscs-2027-paper.description: Public-data repositories whose code and results produce the ISCS 2027 paper's numbers; tag these commits and make the repositories public at submission. The densification exponents come from the private single-author archive (cmri-temporal-networks, branch pilot/iscs-2027-calibration), which stays private.

wildchat-replication-frozen.description: The workspace state recorded in cmri-wildchat-replication's audits/dependencies.json; its pin tests pass only with these repositories at these commits.

reviewed.reason: Per-case score tables (553 cases by 27 methods under four conditions, with case ids, participant numbers and component hashes); no embeddings and no text.
